notes: Version 1.1.1 — Fixes the broken auto-updater. OBS-style flow now: confirm prompt, real download progress bar, then an in-place install with no cmd windows flashing on screen. Yes/No buttons on the update prompt are clickable again (the frameless-window event filter was eating the clicks). Also fixes a version-compare bug where 1.1.0 was being seen as newer than 1.1, which kept retriggering the update prompt on a current-version build.
